column1: # The PGS Catalog scores step 25 and the PRS process run, one per line.
# trait_reported is the trait exactly as https://www.pgscatalog.org/rest/score/<pgs_id>
# reports it; scripts/ci/check-pgs-labels.sh compares the two, so an id
# cannot be printed under the wrong disease. setup.sh downloads each score's
# applies_to names the sex a score was built for (female or male; empty for
# both). A sample declared as the other sex keeps the score's raw sum in the
# summary, marked "not applicable to the declared sex", with no percentile.
